evidence.computation: Cooling and time-without-temperature-control verdicts reject negative elapsed durations; a passing verdict is bound to a nonnegative duration within the declared stage limit.
assumptions: The question maps to the declared cooling stage or four-hour timing model.
These computations concern the stated numbers and do not determine whether a specific food is safe.
untrusted: Natural-language stage selection, elapsed-time parsing, and the applicability of the declared rule to the situation.
